notes: The Redevelopment Agency's Western Addition A-2 Market Data Study, SFH371-5020 to 5023 (four volumes: vacant land and single-family, residential-commercial and commercial, two and three units, four plus units), compiled about 1970. The front pages' typed fields are faint and OCR badly, so address, type, year built and area were read by eye from cropped strips of the page images; recording date and price come from the sales pages, which OCR well, agreed across three passes.
